# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, 26.3's file against 26.4's.
# Copper golem, round 1: the entity, its brain and the behavior that carries items between containers.
find CopperGolem
find TransportItems
find ContainerInteraction
findsig CopperGolem
findsig TransportItemsBetweenContainers
findcalls CopperGolem
findcalls TransportItemsBetweenContainers
uses net/minecraft/world/entity/ai/behavior/TransportItemsBetweenContainers
data tags/block/copper_golem_statues.json
data tags/item/copper_golem_transportable.json
